changelog:
- Added clear description and usage guidance for integrating Sendbird Chat Platform API v3 with caller-owned credentials.
- Outlined preview-first, explicit confirmation workflow for all mutations to prevent unintended changes.
- Detailed boundary for credentials, emphasizing local environment use and non-persistence in documentation.
- Provided example scenarios for user lookups, sending messages, and channel deletion, illustrating workflow via CLI.
- Clarified contract provenance and compliance responsibility, noting unaffiliation with Sendbird.
summary: Use for Sendbird Chat Platform API v3 server-side integration — users, group channels, open channels, messages, metadata, moderation, bots, announcements, and statistics — with caller-owned application credentials and preview-first mutation confirmation.
